OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P57 ?dir } OPTIONAL { ?item p:P2142 ?st . ?st psv:P2142 ?v . ?v wikibase:quantityAmount ?amt ; wikibase:quantityUnit wd:Q4917 } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true .
